program.name: Yoga 35
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of yoga: an energising morning flow or a slower evening one.
program.about: Yoga for about half an hour, matched to the time of day. The morning flow is sun salutations and standing poses that wake you up; the evening one is moon salutations, floor poses and a long rest. They alternate. Level II holds every pose longer and Level III brings harder poses.
